questions.q: What is the sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral?
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral can be divided into 2 triangles, so 2 × 180° = 360°.

questions.q: Which quadrilateral has all sides equal and all angles 90°?
questions.explanation: A square has equal sides and right angles.

options: bisect each other at right angles
questions.explanation: This is a property of a rhombus.

questions.q: The diagonals of a rectangle are ____.
questions.explanation: In a rectangle, both diagonals have the same length.

questions.q: In a parallelogram, adjacent angles are ____.

options: exactly one pair of parallel sides
questions.explanation: This is the definition of a trapezium.
